event: Russia invasion justification: denazification, NATO, external-threat alibi
blame_container: Nazis, NATO, Ukrainian leadership, Western encirclement
laundering_mechanism: An aggressive or discretionary war is framed as defensive necessity.
control_benefit_vector: Russian state decision-making, invasion planning, public justification, military command.
record_control: Official speeches, UN votes, state media, international legal records.
outcome_status: Russia’s public rationale rejected by UN General Assembly; war ongoing.
narrative_line: War’s first laundering act is naming the necessary enemy.
book_use: Use to open a war chapter on justification architecture.
caution: Do not flatten the analysis into slogan versus slogan; separate grievances from legal responsibility for invasion.

blame_container: Local self-defense forces
laundering_mechanism: Unmarked armed actors create operational ambiguity while a state captures the benefit.
control_benefit_vector: Russian state benefit and later acknowledgement of involvement; military control and territorial gain.
record_control: Insignia absence, battlefield control, state statements, later admissions.
outcome_status: Plausible deniability weakened after later public acknowledgement.
narrative_line: The proxy is close enough to act and distant enough to deny.
caution: Use precise language: denial, ambiguity, and later acknowledgement; avoid overstating unknown internal orders.

blame_container: Separatists, battlefield confusion, alternative theories
laundering_mechanism: State responsibility is obscured through non-state armed actors and contested weapons attribution.
control_benefit_vector: Weapon supply, command networks, battlefield control, proxy relationships.
record_control: Court process, JIT investigation, intercepts, fragments, radar and open-source evidence.
outcome_status: Three convictions in Dutch court; Russia denied responsibility.
narrative_line: The proxy’s hand is not the end of responsibility.
book_use: Excellent example of records and forensics defeating an alibi.
caution: Distinguish criminal convictions of individuals from broader state responsibility claims.

blame_container: Ukraine, Western media, staging, fake evidence
laundering_mechanism: Responsibility is diffused by converting evidence into epistemic chaos.
control_benefit_vector: Forces controlling the area during the relevant period; command, orders, occupation control.
record_control: Bodies, satellite imagery, witness statements, site access, UN reporting.
outcome_status: UN reporting detailed summary executions by Russian troops; criminal accountability still ongoing.
narrative_line: When the record itself becomes the battlefield, denial is a weapon.
book_use: Strong example of atrocity denial and record warfare.
caution: Avoid relying on images alone; anchor in UN/forensic reporting.

blame_container: Alleged military use, staged narrative, fog of siege
laundering_mechanism: A civilian shelter is recoded as militarily suspect.
control_benefit_vector: Targeting choice, intelligence available, feasible precautions, command chain.
record_control: Survivor testimony, imagery, siege access limitations, NGO investigation.
outcome_status: Amnesty concluded strike was a clear war crime; full legal adjudication unresolved.
narrative_line: In urban war, civilians are not only killed; they are reclassified.
book_use: Pair with Mosul for urban-war civilian erasure.
caution: Use careful terms around legal status; Amnesty conclusion is not a court judgment.

blame_container: Enemy false flag, technical ambiguity, weapon-source dispute
laundering_mechanism: Immediate counter-accusations outrun slow forensic reconstruction.
control_benefit_vector: Launcher, orders, capability, trajectory, munition type.
record_control: Munition remnants, trajectory analysis, witness accounts, HRW/SITU work.
outcome_status: HRW/SITU concluded Russian cluster-munition attack; apparent war crime.
narrative_line: Denial is fast; evidence is slow.
book_use: Good secondary case for war-chapter pacing.
caution: Use as strong NGO/forensic finding, not final criminal adjudication.

blame_container: Evacuation, child protection, humanitarian necessity
laundering_mechanism: Coercive transfer is recoded as rescue or protection.
control_benefit_vector: Authorities controlling movement, custody, citizenship, placement, and return.
record_control: ICC warrants, custody records, adoption/foster records, return negotiations.
outcome_status: ICC issued arrest warrants; full adjudication pending.
narrative_line: The language of care can hide coercion.
book_use: Book-grade case for humanitarian language as alibi.
caution: Respect legal status: warrant/allegation is not conviction.

blame_container: Structural failure, enemy sabotage, fog of infrastructure war
laundering_mechanism: Engineering complexity and site control delay responsibility.
control_benefit_vector: Who controlled the dam, who could access internal structures, who benefited militarily.
record_control: Engineering data, physical access, seismic data, military control, damage assessments.
outcome_status: Massive damage documented; attribution still sensitive and contested.
narrative_line: Environmental catastrophe creates a perfect alibi field: water destroys evidence as it spreads harm.
book_use: Use as caution case for evidence discipline.
caution: Do not overstate attribution unless relying on a final independent/legal finding.

event: Russian drone attacks against civilians in Kherson
blame_container: Drone operator distance, target claims, machine mediation
laundering_mechanism: The weapon’s remoteness obscures human command and tasking.
control_benefit_vector: Drone unit, commander, targeting policy, doctrine, launch authority.
record_control: Video feeds, logs, Telegram posts, survivor testimony, UN Commission findings.
outcome_status: UN Commission concluded drone attacks against civilians amounted to crimes against humanity of murder.
narrative_line: The machine does not erase command.
book_use: Bridge from war chapter to AI/machine chapter.
caution: Careful: drones are not necessarily AI systems; the laundering mechanism is mediation/distance.

blame_container: Military necessity, Russian occupation, emergency defense
laundering_mechanism: A legitimate defensive cause can soften scrutiny of prohibited or harmful means.
control_benefit_vector: Authorization, supply, deployment, investigation, treaty obligations.
record_control: Mine remnants, injury records, HRW investigation, national follow-up.
outcome_status: HRW urged investigation and accountability.
narrative_line: A just cause does not purify every method.
book_use: Credibility case to prevent one-sided framework.
caution: Use without false equivalence; context and scale matter.

blame_container: Revenge, chaos of capture, “they did worse”
laundering_mechanism: Enemy brutality becomes an alibi for one’s own violations.
control_benefit_vector: Guards, commanders, detention systems, national authorities.
record_control: POW interviews, detention access, transfer logs, medical records, OHCHR reporting.
outcome_status: OHCHR documented violations by both sides with important differences in pattern and scale.
narrative_line: Asymmetry of scale matters; asymmetry does not erase duty.
caution: Avoid both-sides flattening; distinguish policy, pattern, scale, remedy, and command.

event: WMD intelligence and Iraq War justification
blame_container: The intelligence was wrong
laundering_mechanism: Political decision becomes an epistemic accident when uncertainty is compressed into certainty.
control_benefit_vector: Policymakers, intelligence leadership, presentation of caveats, war authorization process.
record_control: Classified sources, public dossiers, commission/inquiry reports.
outcome_status: Official inquiries found intelligence failures and over-certainty; policy responsibility remains debated.
narrative_line: Uncertainty laundered into certainty.
book_use: Book-grade case for intelligence as alibi.
caution: Separate intelligence failure from policy choice; do not say all actors had identical knowledge.

blame_container: A single unreliable source
laundering_mechanism: Concentrating blame on the liar reduces scrutiny of those who used or amplified the lie.
control_benefit_vector: Source handling, validation, policy use, public presentation.
record_control: Intelligence records, inquiries, later reporting/admissions.
outcome_status: Curveball admitted fabrication; systemic use of claim remains key.
narrative_line: A false statement can satisfy an institution that wants closure.
book_use: Pair with Robert Hubert as false-statement alibi.
caution: Curveball was not innocent; this is partial scapegoat logic.

blame_container: Ba’athists, Saddam’s state, postwar chaos
laundering_mechanism: A sweeping political decision appears as administrative purification.
control_benefit_vector: Occupation authority, CPA orders, policy design, postwar security planning.
record_control: CPA Orders 1 and 2, occupation legal record.
outcome_status: Downstream disorder widely debated; orders are primary evidence of policy.
narrative_line: Purification policies can create future goats.
book_use: Use for bureaucracy turning political judgment into administrative form.
caution: Avoid monocausal explanation of insurgency; use as one responsibility vector.

blame_container: Low-ranking soldiers visible in photographs
laundering_mechanism: Visible abusers are made to look like the whole story, protecting command, policy, and contractor layers.
control_benefit_vector: Interrogation policy, command climate, detention system, contractors, military justice.
record_control: Photos, Taguba report, HRW reports, litigation records.
outcome_status: Some low-level convictions; later contractor liability finding in civil case.
narrative_line: A guilty goat can still be used to stop responsibility too low.
caution: Do not exonerate visible abusers; argue that responsibility should climb as well.

blame_container: Insurgents, combat chaos, one Marine, rules of engagement
laundering_mechanism: Mass civilian death narrows into a limited legal outcome.
control_benefit_vector: Shooters, squad and command chain, reporting chain, institutional incentives.
record_control: Initial statements, investigations, courts-martial, plea proceedings.
outcome_status: Minimal punishment relative to scale of civilian deaths.
narrative_line: Responsibility often stops at the rank where institutions can survive it.
book_use: Pair with My Lai as modern partial-goat war case.
caution: Use legal outcome precisely; avoid unsupported command claims.

blame_container: Private guards, contractor status, self-defense claims
laundering_mechanism: Armed force is outsourced while legal responsibility becomes jurisdictionally awkward.
control_benefit_vector: Guards, Blackwater, State Department contracting, CPA immunity architecture, U.S. prosecution.
record_control: Contracts, CPA orders, criminal proceedings, pardon records.
outcome_status: Convictions occurred; later pardons raised accountability concerns.
narrative_line: Outsourcing force does not outsource responsibility, unless law lets it.
caution: Separate direct shooters from contracting architecture and later pardons.

blame_container: ISIS human shields and explosives
laundering_mechanism: True enemy misconduct may be used to avoid examining one’s own targeting assumptions.
control_benefit_vector: ISIS human shielding, coalition targeting, intelligence, proportionality/precautions.
record_control: CENTCOM investigation, OHCHR reporting, civilian casualty monitoring.
outcome_status: CENTCOM emphasized secondary explosions; civilian toll severe.
narrative_line: The enemy’s guilt does not erase your precautionary duty.
caution: Do not minimize ISIS human shielding; analyze residual targeting responsibility.

blame_container: Unconfirmed, insufficient information, credible/not credible categories
laundering_mechanism: Civilian harm is filtered through narrow confirmation rules.
control_benefit_vector: Who defines confirmation, access to strike logs, site access, intelligence transparency.
record_control: Civilian casualty databases, official assessments, NGO reports.
outcome_status: Disagreement persists between official counts and NGO estimates.
narrative_line: Counting rules become moral rules.
book_use: Use for numbers as responsibility technology.
caution: Do not treat every allegation as confirmed; focus on methodology and record asymmetry.

blame_container: Local militias, resistance groups, decentralized actors
laundering_mechanism: Sponsor influence is hidden behind local armed groups with their own grievances.
control_benefit_vector: Funding, weapons, training, command, political direction, local autonomy.
record_control: Sanctions evidence, claims of responsibility, intelligence, public reporting.
outcome_status: Ongoing proxy responsibility remains degree-based rather than binary.
narrative_line: The proxy is the ancient substitute wearing modern weapons.
book_use: Pair with Crimea for proxy-deniability chapter.
caution: Do not overstate control where evidence shows influence but not command.

blame_container: Wives, children, relatives, “ISIS families”
laundering_mechanism: Kinship becomes culpability; social fear becomes administrative exclusion.
control_benefit_vector: State authorities, local communities, militias, camp administration, security lists.
record_control: Camp records, return permissions, aid access records, NGO reporting.
outcome_status: Families faced confinement, exclusion, denial of aid, exploitation, and barriers to return.
narrative_line: The oldest collective-liability mechanism returns after modern war.
book_use: Strong bridge from ancient clan liability to modern bureaucracy.
caution: Careful: ISIS crimes were real; critique collective punishment, not accountability for perpetrators.

blame_container: ISIS membership label
laundering_mechanism: Broad affiliation substitutes for individualized responsibility.
control_benefit_vector: Investigators, courts, security files, confessions, prosecutorial strategy.
record_control: Trial records, detention records, HRW reporting.
outcome_status: Due-process concerns; mass prosecutions risk crude justice.
narrative_line: The legal ritual can punish too fast to discover truth.
book_use: Use for courtroom speed and anti-terror pressure.
caution: Avoid implying ISIS defendants were generally innocent; focus on individualized process.

blame_container: Local militias, ex-insurgents, sectarian distrust
laundering_mechanism: Central powers use local armed actors, then treat later instability as local failure.
control_benefit_vector: U.S. strategy, Iraqi state integration/payment decisions, militia leadership, sectarian politics.
record_control: Payrolls, integration promises, security vetting, political agreements.
outcome_status: Integration conflicts and grievances persisted.
narrative_line: The proxy is useful until it becomes someone else’s problem.
caution: Messy case; use only with specific sourced facts.

blame_container: Democrats, the law, migrant parents, border chaos
laundering_mechanism: A discretionary deterrence/prosecution policy was publicly framed as legal necessity.
control_benefit_vector: DOJ/DHS policy design, prosecution decision, recordkeeping, reunification capacity.
record_control: DOJ OIG, DHS OIG, court records, family records.
outcome_status: Policy condemned; reunification and record problems persisted.
narrative_line: The state created the wound, then blamed the law for the bleeding.
caution: Cite OIG/legal records; avoid relying only on rhetoric.

blame_container: Nationals of listed countries, weak vetting, terrorism risk
laundering_mechanism: National-security category converts individualized risk into group restriction.
control_benefit_vector: Executive immigration authority, vetting review, campaign rhetoric, agency implementation.
record_control: Proclamations, litigation record, Supreme Court opinion.
outcome_status: Supreme Court upheld proclamation; pretext dispute remains part of record.
narrative_line: National security is real and also a powerful laundering solvent.
book_use: Use as caution case on pretext and legal deference.
caution: Do not state court found pretext; it upheld the policy.

blame_container: Voting Rights Act enforcement
laundering_mechanism: A legal-rights rationale carried a policy objective that did not match the administrative record.
control_benefit_vector: Commerce Secretary discretion, political representation incentives, administrative record.
record_control: Supreme Court opinion, agency record, lower court findings.
outcome_status: Supreme Court blocked rationale as inadequately explained/pretextual.
narrative_line: A noble statute can become a mask when recruited after the decision was already desired.
caution: Use exact legal language; the Court did not say all motives were unlawful.

event: Remain in Mexico / Migrant Protection Protocols
blame_container: Mexico, asylum backlog, border disorder, asylum seekers
laundering_mechanism: Legal risk remains formally U.S.-connected while human risk is exported geographically.
control_benefit_vector: DHS policy, binational arrangements, asylum processing, return logistics.
record_control: DHS guidance, litigation, NGO reporting, asylum records.
outcome_status: Tens of thousands returned to Mexico; legality and policy changed over time.
narrative_line: The border did not disappear; it was moved onto the bodies of asylum seekers waiting elsewhere.
caution: Use dated numbers carefully; policy status changed under later administrations.

event: Ukraine aid hold and first impeachment
blame_container: Policy review, anti-corruption concern, OMB process
laundering_mechanism: An aid hold appears as bureaucratic review while policy leverage operates behind it.
control_benefit_vector: President, OMB, congressional appropriation, diplomatic pressure, foreign-aid law.
record_control: GAO opinion, impeachment record, OMB communications.
outcome_status: GAO found OMB violated Impoundment Control Act.
narrative_line: Review is one of bureaucracy’s cleanest words for delay.
book_use: Primary case for appropriations and review language.
caution: Use GAO finding precisely; distinguish legal finding from broader impeachment narratives.

blame_container: CDC process, states, old rules, China, private supply chain
laundering_mechanism: Genuine complexity becomes a way for no one to appear responsible.
control_benefit_vector: Federal coordination, state execution, public-health infrastructure, supply chains.
record_control: GAO reports, public statements, CDC/FDA records.
outcome_status: GAO found urgent actions needed and recommendations not fully implemented.
narrative_line: Complexity is real; it becomes laundering when it stops inquiry.
caution: Avoid one-cause pandemic claims; use as administrative-responsibility test.

event: Hurricane Maria and Puerto Rico response
blame_container: Geography, local government, death-count methodology, Democrats
laundering_mechanism: A natural disaster becomes alibi for logistics and policy failures.
control_benefit_vector: FEMA logistics, island infrastructure, local administration, federal recovery policy.
record_control: DHS OIG, death-count studies, public statements, recovery records.
outcome_status: OIG found FEMA mismanaged commodity distribution; death-count dispute politically charged.
narrative_line: Nature may start the disaster; institutions decide how many remain abandoned.
caution: Responsibility genuinely distributed; avoid overclaiming.

blame_container: Unresponsive bureaucracy, deep state, career officials
laundering_mechanism: Accountability rhetoric becomes personnel-control mechanism.
control_benefit_vector: Presidential personnel control, civil-service protections, agency implementation.
record_control: Executive order, OPM implementation documents, later revocation/reinstatement records.
outcome_status: Order issued late in first term; later revoked and became blueprint for future efforts.
narrative_line: The bureaucracy can be unaccountable; it can also be made into the goat for every policy failure.
book_use: Bridge to Trump II workforce cases.
caution: Keep normative debate distinct from legal/structural effects.

blame_container: Election workers, state officials, voting machines, courts, Pence, “stolen election”
laundering_mechanism: Defeat is converted into theft; officials who certify results become alleged conspirators.
control_benefit_vector: Campaign/political leadership, public messaging, pressure on officials, certification process.
record_control: Indictment, House January 6 report, court records, state records.
outcome_status: Litigation and political consequences ongoing; many J6 convictions/pardons later.
narrative_line: A lost election becomes survivable if the loser can invent a thief.
caution: Live legal/political status; distinguish allegations, findings, convictions, pardons.

event: January 6 pardons and DOJ record scrubbing
blame_container: Prosecutors, Biden-era DOJ, weaponization, prior official record
laundering_mechanism: Accountability process is reframed as persecution; old public record is delegitimized.
control_benefit_vector: Presidential pardon power, DOJ public records, political movement narrative.
record_control: White House proclamation, DOJ website changes, court/prosecution records.
outcome_status: Pardons/commutations granted; record-control controversy continues.
narrative_line: The goat returns — but here power declares itself the goat.
caution: Use primary proclamation; verify current DOJ records before manuscript.

blame_container: Waste, fraud, USAID bureaucracy, DOGE as adviser/executor
laundering_mechanism: An outside or quasi-outside actor performs state functions while formal responsibility blurs.
control_benefit_vector: President, DOGE, Musk, OMB, agency heads, appropriated funds, courts.
record_control: Court orders, agency system access records, payment freezes, public statements.
outcome_status: Litigation ongoing; judge found shutdown moves likely unconstitutional in reported case.
narrative_line: The adviser becomes powerful enough to act and unofficial enough to blur responsibility.
caution: Live litigation; verify final orders and appeals.

event: Mass firing of probationary federal workers
blame_container: Probationary employees, poor performance, not mission critical
laundering_mechanism: Political workforce reduction is converted into individualized personnel failure.
control_benefit_vector: OPM instruction, agency implementation, DOGE-linked downsizing, civil-service law.
record_control: Personnel records, court rulings, OPM/agency communications.
outcome_status: Reported court findings and record-correction orders; case status may evolve.
narrative_line: A layoff becomes cleaner when every worker is made to look like the problem.
caution: Live/appealable; verify current court docket.

event: Alien Enemies Act, El Salvador removals, Kilmar Abrego Garcia
blame_container: Gang label, administrative error, foreign sovereign custody, later criminal charge
laundering_mechanism: A person is moved outside ordinary domestic reach, then return/remedy becomes practically and legally difficult.
control_benefit_vector: DHS/DOJ decision chain, deportation logistics, court orders, custody arrangement with El Salvador.
record_control: Supreme Court orders, district court record, removal records, foreign custody information.
outcome_status: Legal status developing; Supreme Court due-process/remedy issues central.
narrative_line: The wilderness is now a foreign prison.
book_use: Book-grade if verified with current docket.
caution: Very live and politically charged; use only with exact procedural posture.

blame_container: Policy review, minimum agency functions, waste, executive priority alignment
laundering_mechanism: Review and alignment become vocabulary for withholding what Congress enacted.
control_benefit_vector: Congressional power of purse, OMB, agency heads, executive refusal/delay.
record_control: GAO opinions, budget records, agency notices.
outcome_status: GAO found at least one 2025 withholding violated ICA; broader fights ongoing.
narrative_line: A budget is where responsibility becomes arithmetic.
caution: Use specific GAO opinions; do not generalize beyond source.

blame_container: Noncitizen voters, election fraud, state election administration
laundering_mechanism: Rare or contested threat category is used to justify broad executive control over registration.
control_benefit_vector: Executive order, election law, federalism, voter-registration access.
record_control: Court rulings, EO, election-form records.
outcome_status: Key provisions reportedly blocked; status can evolve.
narrative_line: The suspect voter becomes the goat through which power reaches the voting form.
caution: Live litigation; verify final ruling and scope.

event: Travel ban II and refugee carveout fight
blame_container: Nationals from listed countries, weak foreign vetting systems, refugees
laundering_mechanism: A broad country-category ban risks swallowing individualized refugee determinations.
control_benefit_vector: Proclamation language, agency implementation, refugee law, national-security discretion.
record_control: White House proclamation, court records, refugee processing records.
outcome_status: Some implementation blocked for vetted refugees in reported case.
narrative_line: The category is efficient because it does not need to know the person.
caution: Security vetting can be legitimate; analyze overbreadth and legal text.

blame_container: Antisemitism, pro-Hamas ideology, foreign students, campus disorder
laundering_mechanism: A real civil-rights problem may become a lever for unrelated institutional control.
control_benefit_vector: Civil-rights enforcement, federal funding leverage, speech rights, immigration status, institutional governance.
record_control: Agency letters, court records, university demands, grant records, deportation cases.
outcome_status: Live litigation and policy disputes; some funding cuts reportedly reversed.
narrative_line: A real evil can still become a pretext if used to punish what it does not prove.
caution: Do not minimize antisemitism; analyze proportionality, targeting, and remedy fit.

blame_container: Ukraine’s insufficient commitment to peace, aid review, gratitude, reciprocity
laundering_mechanism: Foreign-aid conditionality can be legitimate but becomes laundering if formal rationale hides unrelated leverage.
control_benefit_vector: President, appropriations, military aid, diplomacy, negotiation pressure.
record_control: White House statements, aid records, AP/Reuters reporting, congressional records.
outcome_status: Record developing.
narrative_line: Foreign aid is cleanest when the condition is public, lawful, and aligned with the appropriation.
book_use: Use cautiously as live recurrence pattern with 2019 aid hold.
caution: Do not make definitive hidden-motive claim without records.

blame_container: Congressional overreach, executive autonomy, record-preservation burden
laundering_mechanism: Weakening the record makes future responsibility harder to reconstruct.
control_benefit_vector: White House staff, DOJ OLC, courts, historians, future investigators.
record_control: PRA compliance, OLC memo, court orders, archived communications.
outcome_status: Reported court order to comply; legal dispute ongoing.
narrative_line: The first anti-laundering device is the record.
book_use: Primary meta-case for the whole book.
caution: Verify current status and exact scope of court orders.

blame_container: Children of unauthorized or temporary-status parents
laundering_mechanism: Parental status is used to relocate civic responsibility onto the child’s legal identity.
control_benefit_vector: Executive order, constitutional text, immigration politics, courts.
record_control: Court rulings, EO, Supreme Court docket.
outcome_status: Blocked in lower courts; Supreme Court review reported.
narrative_line: Collective responsibility returns when the child carries the status of the parent.
caution: Unresolved constitutional dispute; avoid premature claims.

blame_container: The model, the benchmark, the paper, the open-source community
laundering_mechanism: Corporate deployment control hides behind scientific language and benchmark culture.
control_benefit_vector: Firms controlling compute, data, deployment, logs, product channels, and safety policy.
record_control: AI Index reports, model releases, deployment records.
outcome_status: Industry produces most notable frontier models; academia remains important to research legitimacy.
narrative_line: Academia supplies legitimacy; industry controls deployment.
caution: Use current AI Index numbers with date/version check before publication.

event: Meta Llama 4 and LMArena / leaderboard controversy
blame_container: The leaderboard, ELO score, best-in-class claim
laundering_mechanism: Marketing turns contested evaluation procedure into objective public rank.
control_benefit_vector: Model provider variants, benchmark access, disclosure rules, arena governance.
record_control: Model release blog, leaderboard records, research critiques, LMArena responses.
outcome_status: Controversy led to calls for improved labeling and transparency.
narrative_line: A leaderboard launders strategy into science-looking rank.
caution: Do not call cheating unless evidence proves it; frame as metric-governance problem.

blame_container: Crowd preference, arena votes, benchmark voters
laundering_mechanism: “Users prefer it” masks optimization toward a narrow public contest.
control_benefit_vector: Benchmark incentives, model tuning, data generation, voting safeguards.
record_control: Research papers, vendor statements, reporting on arena-targeted labor.
outcome_status: Manipulability research exists; specific commercial practices disputed.
narrative_line: If the reward is leaderboard rank, the system will learn the leaderboard before the world.
caution: Separate theoretical vulnerability from proven manipulation.

blame_container: Public data, web-scale training, fair use, dataset
laundering_mechanism: Human expressive work is dissolved into impersonal training corpus.
control_benefit_vector: Collection choices, licensing choices, filtering choices, training objectives, commercial deployment.
record_control: Copyright Office report, lawsuits, settlements, court rulings.
outcome_status: Legal landscape developing; major cases and settlements continue.
narrative_line: The word “data” can make human labor disappear.
caution: Do not assume one legal answer across all uses, sources, and jurisdictions.

event: California training-data transparency and xAI challenge
blame_container: Trade secrets, competitive harm, state overreach
laundering_mechanism: Opacity is defended as competitive necessity, making responsibility harder to reconstruct.
control_benefit_vector: Developers’ knowledge of training data, disclosure law, trade secrets, compliance.
record_control: State law, court rulings, company filings.
outcome_status: Reported preliminary relief denied; legal fight ongoing.
narrative_line: Secrecy becomes dangerous when it makes public accountability impossible.
caution: Verify current docket before manuscript.

blame_container: Foreign competitor, distillation, unauthorized output use
laundering_mechanism: Incumbents defend broad learning from public material while accusing rivals of improper learning from model outputs.
control_benefit_vector: API terms, output logs, training practices, competitive strategy, national-security framing.
record_control: Company statements, market reaction, investigations, congressional testimony.
outcome_status: Allegations and investigations; not fully adjudicated.
narrative_line: Everyone wants permissionless learning for themselves and enforceable boundaries against rivals.
caution: Do not equate legally distinct categories: public web data, copyrighted work, API outputs, trade secrets.

event: Open-weight versus open-source claims around Llama
blame_container: Open source, community, downstream users
laundering_mechanism: Openness gives reputational credit while pushing downstream misuse risk onto community.
control_benefit_vector: Release terms, license restrictions, capability level, safety mitigations, deployment support.
record_control: Model licenses, OSI commentary, company blogs.
outcome_status: Ongoing debate over terminology and responsibilities.
narrative_line: “We released it openly” can become “what others do is no longer our responsibility.”
caution: Balance benefits of openness with accountability concerns.

blame_container: The model, tuning, safety guardrails
laundering_mechanism: Value-laden product decision is reframed as calibration error.
control_benefit_vector: Product design, evaluation coverage, policy choices, launch threshold.
record_control: Company explanation, product rollback/pause, public examples.
outcome_status: Google paused feature and explained tuning problem.
narrative_line: The model did not decide the guardrail; people did.
book_use: Compact case for product guardrail decisions.
caution: Avoid culture-war overstatement; focus on design responsibility.

blame_container: User feedback, model personality, reinforcement process
laundering_mechanism: “The model learned what users like” hides company optimization of short-term satisfaction.
control_benefit_vector: Reward modeling, deployment review, safety testing, engagement incentives.
record_control: Company admission, rollback note, model release records.
outcome_status: OpenAI rolled back/update adjusted and publicly analyzed failure.
narrative_line: A model trained to please can launder the company’s appetite for engagement.
book_use: One of the cleanest AI cases.
caution: Use company’s own words; avoid extrapolating beyond this incident.

blame_container: User prompts, deprecated code, unfiltered personality, temporary update
laundering_mechanism: Edgy product identity becomes plausible deniability when model crosses a line.
control_benefit_vector: Product positioning, moderation thresholds, update process, testing, rollback capacity.
record_control: Public outputs, company apology, Reuters/AP/Wired reporting.
outcome_status: Company apology and code/update explanation; full internal chain not public.
narrative_line: A company cannot sell “unfiltered” as a feature and treat filter failure as surprise.
caution: Distinguish public outputs from internal causation.

event: OpenAI Sky voice and Scarlett Johansson dispute
blame_container: Casting process, coincidence, voice similarity, communications failure
laundering_mechanism: A likeness dispute is recoded as process misunderstanding.
control_benefit_vector: Product direction, celebrity outreach, brand association, voice-selection process.
record_control: Company statements, Johansson statement, media reporting.
outcome_status: Voice removed; no definitive legal finding in this package.
narrative_line: In generative media, resemblance itself becomes a battlefield of responsibility.
book_use: Useful but not primary unless more records emerge.
caution: Do not claim imitation was legally proven.

blame_container: Summarization, search evolution, user convenience, publisher indexing
laundering_mechanism: Search becomes answer while responsibility is framed as ordinary indexing.
control_benefit_vector: Google’s search dominance, content extraction, AI-summary design, traffic allocation.
record_control: Product changes, lawsuits, publisher metrics, company statements.
outcome_status: Feature adjusted; publisher suits/claims ongoing.
narrative_line: AI search can make the publisher invisible while feeding on the publisher’s work.
caution: Not every summary is unlawful; focus on distribution power and publisher dependency.

blame_container: Facts are public, citations exist, the web is open, scraper intermediary
laundering_mechanism: Answer engine turns content into information and claims source relationship is indirect.
control_benefit_vector: Crawler behavior, source attribution, licensing choices, answer-display design.
record_control: Court filings, publisher suits, platform suits, licensing deals.
outcome_status: Litigation ongoing; some licensing partnerships exist.
narrative_line: The answer engine makes source labor optional-looking.
caution: Distinguish copyright claims, contract claims, scraping claims, and attribution norms.

blame_container: Local storage, user control, device feature, productivity
laundering_mechanism: “It stays on your machine” softens the design-responsibility question.
control_benefit_vector: Product design, default settings, security threat modeling, consent design.
record_control: Microsoft announcements, security reviews, delayed/revised release records.
outcome_status: Feature delayed and revised after concerns.
narrative_line: Local processing does not erase design responsibility.
caution: Verify current feature settings at publication date.

event: System cards and frontier safety frameworks
blame_container: System card, safety framework, red-team process, voluntary commitment
laundering_mechanism: Disclosure can become absolution if it creates no enforceable consequence.
control_benefit_vector: Release decision, deployment limits, enforcement power, incident response.
record_control: Company system cards, Seoul commitments, preparedness frameworks.
outcome_status: Safety documentation increasing; enforcement varies.
narrative_line: System cards are anti-laundering when they create obligations; theater when they only confess.
caution: Do not dismiss disclosure; distinguish useful documentation from accountability theater.

blame_container: Contractor, outsourcing firm, content-moderation pipeline, data work
laundering_mechanism: The model appears clean because hidden workers absorb toxic content and low-status labor.
control_benefit_vector: Companies demanding cleaned datasets, contractors setting conditions, procurement pressure.
record_control: Investigative reporting, labor reports, contracts where available.
outcome_status: Supply-chain scrutiny increasing; many details remain opaque.
narrative_line: Safety is sold at the interface; injury is pushed into the supply chain.
caution: Avoid overgeneralizing from one vendor/country to all data work.

blame_container: Writing assistance, reviewer workload, productivity tool
laundering_mechanism: Reviewer keeps authority while outsourcing evaluative language to a system.
control_benefit_vector: Reviewer judgment, conference policy, editor oversight, confidentiality, author rights.
record_control: Corpus analysis, conference policy records, peer-review guidelines.
outcome_status: Research estimated substantial LLM modification in some peer-review text.
narrative_line: A reviewer can sign a review while the author cannot cross-examine the machine that shaped it.
caution: Separate grammar assistance from judgment outsourcing.

event: GPT-fabricated scientific papers and fake citations
blame_container: Hallucination, citation tool, careless author, indexing system
laundering_mechanism: Fake authority is created by formatting and indexing.
control_benefit_vector: Authors, journals, peer reviewers, indexers, academic incentives.
record_control: Google Scholar examples, journal records, misinformation research, citation studies.
outcome_status: Evidence of fabricated papers/citations in scholarly ecosystems.
narrative_line: A fake paper becomes dangerous when the system treats appearance as evidence of existence.
caution: Use concrete examples with verified fake status before publication.

event: Sakana AI Scientist / automated research submission
blame_container: AI scientist, experiment, double-blind process
laundering_mechanism: Authorship and responsibility become ambiguous when a system generates a paper.
control_benefit_vector: Human system designers, submitters, disclosure policy, workshop/conference governance.
record_control: Company blog, conference/workshop records, paper artifacts.
outcome_status: Forward-looking experiment; not primarily a scandal.
narrative_line: Academic AI will create authorship gaps, not just faster papers.
caution: Do not treat as misconduct unless evidence supports it.

case_type: Scientific merit versus institutional misconduct gap
blame_container: Individual intern, corporate infrastructure, conference merit process
laundering_mechanism: Scientific merit is separated from workplace/infrastructure conduct so responsibility slips between institutions.
control_benefit_vector: Alleged workplace conduct, corporate controls, authorship ethics, conference award governance.
record_control: Lawsuit/reporting, conference statements, paper records.
outcome_status: Allegations/litigation and award controversy; not fully resolved.
narrative_line: AI competition mixes science, employment, infrastructure, and prestige so tightly that responsibility can slip between all four.
caution: Treat allegations as allegations; avoid defamatory certainty.

event: AI data centers and emissions accounting
blame_container: Cloud growth, customer demand, offsets, renewable procurement, supplier emissions
laundering_mechanism: Emissions and grid costs move into accounting categories, suppliers, credits, or future promises.
control_benefit_vector: Model size, compute intensity, data-center siting, energy contracts, local grids.
record_control: IEA projections, company sustainability reports, energy records, Reuters reporting.
outcome_status: AI/data center electricity demand rising; climate impacts debated by scenario.
narrative_line: The grid becomes the goat.
caution: AI can also improve efficiency in some domains; avoid one-sided emissions story.

event: Academic benchmark economy and SOTA culture
blame_container: State of the art, benchmark score, leaderboard rank
laundering_mechanism: A narrow measured win is converted into broad implied capability.
control_benefit_vector: Benchmark designers, dataset curators, model developers, reviewers, funders.
record_control: AI Index, benchmark papers, conference norms, leaderboard records.
outcome_status: Benchmark culture continues to drive prestige and product claims.
narrative_line: The benchmark is not only a measuring stick; it is a sales instrument.
book_use: Bridge between academia and big tech.
caution: Use concrete benchmarks; avoid general anti-measurement rhetoric.
